# bob albums

Inspect album notes

```text title="bob albums --help"
Inspect album notes

Bare `bob albums` runs the read-only list. `list` shows albums grouped by root. `check` lints albums against the contract. `bob albums create` ships in a later phase.

Usage: bob albums [COMMAND]

Commands:
  check  Check albums against the contract
  list   List albums grouped by root (default)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob albums` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  bob albums                       List albums grouped by root
  bob albums list -r body          List one root's albums
  bob albums check                 Lint albums against the contract
  bob albums check -f json         Findings as JSON

See docs/records.md for the album contract.
Run 'bob albums <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob albums check

Check albums against the contract

```text title="bob albums check --help"
Findings grouped by album, plus an album/record/error/warning summary. Exits 1 on any error, 0 otherwise. This command is read-only.

Usage: bob albums check [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob albums check
  bob albums check -f json

See docs/records.md for the album contract.
```

## bob albums list

List albums grouped by root (default)

```text title="bob albums list --help"
Albums grouped by root, with titles, record counts, group counts, freshness, and issue markers. This command is read-only. Bare `bob albums` runs this command. `bob albums create` ships in a later phase.

Usage: bob albums list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -r, --root <ROOT>
          Filter to one computed root identity

Examples:
  bob albums
  bob albums list
  bob albums list -r body -f json

See docs/records.md for the album contract.
```
